description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Nocturne''' terrorizes all enemy champions, [[File:Nearsight icon.png|20px|link=Nearsight|An icon representing the keyword Nearsight]] [[:Nearsight|nearsighting]] them for 6 seconds, during which their [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] radius is reduced by 300 units. He can recast ''Paranoia'' for the same duration after 0.25 seconds.

notes.text:
Nocturne will track the target if they change locations.
* He will not stop tracking the target until he reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
Enemy players affected by Paranoia's nearsight cannot interact with the allied portrait icons on the HUD.
Paranoia's nearsight will apply to enemy champions that are untargetable or are dead, and will persist through death.
Nocturne can cast any of his abilities, summoner spells (excluding Hexflash), or item actives during flight.
* Using a dash or blink ability will interrupt the flight.
* The flight will also be interrupted if Nocturne is affected by a Blast Cone triggered by an allied champion.(bug)
Paranoia cannot be recast while grounded or rooted.
Paranoia's nearsight does not apply to clones.
Players' screens will turn a different color when Paranoia is cast, based on their perspective: blue for allies and red for enemies.
* If an existing player overlay is overwritten, it will not be added back once Paranoia ends. [https://www.twitch.tv/scrubnoob/clip/BoxyEmpathicJayBCouch-6jetjjqssFUY5ACY] (unexpected)Category:Unexpected behaviours
Experimental Hexplate's Overdrive, Fiendhunter Bolts' Opening Barrage, and Zeke's Convergence's Frostfire Tempest will activate immediately upon Paranoia's first cast. If the recast is used, the buff's duration is refreshed at the end of the dash.
